title: Build introspection from whichever signal fired; flag missing one
summary: In backtest.rs, introspection_for will build the record from the earliest valid citation of any fired D87 run: an intervention event, or for a derived host-error record its source intervention. run_on_from will add a finding when a decision is under review and no introspection record was built. Tests use fixture records copying ar1x's intervention and its derived host-error record.

defaults_applied.how: The fix ties introspection to whichever signal fired, not to a patch for the ar1x case.
Fixture tests added to backtest.rs; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Behavior is checked by running the new fixture tests.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The new finding uses condition `d`, the introspection condition, and applies to any decision under review, not only D87.

For a derived record, the introspection takes its intervention, job, class of work and time from the source intervention row in records.interventions; the earliest valid citation is chosen by (time, id).

Observed host-error records have no intervention row, so they are not used as introspection sources unless the Introspection struct can carry them without a schema change. Otherwise they are left out and the missing-record finding fires.
Earlier cases are the same signal's earlier citations, resolved to intervention ids, so the existing check_introspection still applies.
Citations that fail validate_citations are skipped when choosing the earliest.
The fixtures are in-memory Records built in the existing tests module; no real records/ are read.

acceptance_criteria.text: introspection_for in crates/athena-cli/src/backtest.rs no longer requires run.events to be non-empty. It selects the earliest valid citation among the run's intervention events, observed host-error records and derived records, using a derived record's source intervention.
The D87 filter in run_on_from no longer has the `!r.events.is_empty()` restriction.
run_on_from pushes a Finding when a decision is in under_review and report.introspection is None, naming the decision.

Run `cargo test -p athena-cli backtest`. A fixture whose records copy ar1x (the intervention and its derived host-error record) gives D87 under review, a Some(introspection) whose intervention is the source intervention, job and class of work match ar1x, and no findings.
Run `cargo test -p athena-cli backtest`. A fixture where a decision is under review but no introspection can be built gives a finding naming that decision.
Existing backtest tests still pass. `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean.

out_of_scope: Running the backtest on the real records (after landing).
Changing signal definitions, thresholds or the derive_host_error logic in athena-core.
Writing the language-model fields of the introspection record.
